version.description: Format version, MAJOR.MINOR, shared with the script format. See docs/script-format.md.

name.description: What to call this runner in output. Defaults to the file's name.

executable.description: The program that launches an implementation, for example ruby or python3. May use ${runnerDir}, which stands for the directory this runner file was read from. Added in 0.8.

arguments.description: Arguments the runner always passes, before the ones naming the program to run. May use ${runnerDir}. Added in 0.8.

env.description: Environment the runner needs. Merged with the script's own env, which wins where the two name the same variable. Values may use ${runnerDir}, which is how a runner names a shim file that sits beside it. Added in 0.8.

terminal.description: What the program finds on its standard streams. 'pty' (the default) gives it a pseudo-terminal, which is what an interactive program is normally run under; 'pipes' does not. Added in 0.6. Set here when a language's programs need one or the other; a script that names its own wins.

inheritEnv.description: Put prescript's own environment underneath the declared env. Set by either the runner or the script.
